name: overall_recovery_rate
detail: Topic alignment at cosine >= 0.70; every topic must recover in at least 80% of folds.

name: topic_1_recovery_rate
detail: Fixed-seed within-deal family bootstrap; cosine >= 0.70; 80/100 replicates recovered the aligned component.

name: topic_2_recovery_rate
detail: Fixed-seed within-deal family bootstrap; cosine >= 0.70; 96/100 replicates recovered the aligned component.

name: topic_3_recovery_rate
detail: Fixed-seed within-deal family bootstrap; cosine >= 0.70; 98/100 replicates recovered the aligned component.

name: overall_recovery_rate
detail: Complementary robustness diagnostic only, not a topic-selection or relabeling rule; family representatives are resampled with replacement within each deal while preserving every deal's fit-row count and the original fitted vocabulary.

name: lsa_components
detail: Fixed-seed randomized TruncatedSVD of word/bigram TF-IDF; these are local LSA embeddings, not transformer semantic embeddings.

name: lsa_fit_coverage_rate
detail: Nonzero LSA rows from the exact NMF fit universe; projected passages are excluded.

name: hdbscan_min_cluster_size
detail: Prespecified sklearn HDBSCAN parameter; min_samples=None, Euclidean metric, EOM selection, and single-cluster solutions disabled.

name: hdbscan_noise_count
detail: Fit-universe passages HDBSCAN marked as noise, including any zero LSA rows.

name: hdbscan_cluster_count
detail: Non-noise HDBSCAN clusters; cluster count is discovered, not set to selected NMF k.

name: hdbscan_nmf_adjusted_rand
detail: ARI on 524 non-noise shared fit rows only; no recovery threshold and no role in model selection.

name: agglomerative_nmf_adjusted_rand
detail: Cosine/average agglomerative clustering of normalized LSA rows with selected NMF k; ARI uses the same nonzero fit rows and has no role in model selection.
